newsitem.title: INDIA: Japan's Koyo Seiko to raise Sona stake.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Koyo Seiko to raise Sona stake.

text.p: India's Sona Steering Systems Ltd said on Wednesday that Japan's Koyo Seiko Co Ltd will increase its stake in the joint venture to 20.5 percent from 7.9 percent.
Sona Steering said in a statement released in the Indian capital that Koyo Seiko would increase its stake by purchasing 1.2 million preference shares issued at a premium of 82 rupees per share.
Sona Steering is a joint venture of Maruti Udyog Ltd and Koyo Seiko.
"The increase in equity of Koyo in Sona Steering will help finance Sona's expansion plans, particularly the development of power steering gears," the statement said.

The statement said the increased equity would give Sona Steering "tremendous advantage as Koyo is the only steering manufacturer in the world to cater to global customers with manufacturing facilities in all major markets".
It said Koyo was expected to become the world's leading steering maker by 2000.
